title: Vegetarian Cacio e Pepe Fettuccine
description: A vegetarian twist on the classic Italian pasta dish, featuring a rich and creamy sauce made with roasted tomatoes.
instructions: Toss cherry tomatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast for 15-20 minutes.
Cook fettuccine according to package instructions. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
In a large saucepan, combine roasted tomatoes, Cacio e Pepe, and garlic. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Add reserved pasta water and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Combine cooked fettuccine and tomato sauce. Toss to coat, adding more pasta water if needed.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
